exposure: Interest in a worksite wellness program
cohort: Participants included 154 Head Start (HS) staff members from eight HS centers (4 rural, 4 urban) in Colorado.
finding: The study found that 56% of Head Start teachers were overweight or obese, 89% wanted to be more active, and 86.6% desired wellness programming, with consistent motivators, barriers, and topic interests across survey and interview data.
